publications.label: Reference atlas
publications.title: An expanded registry of candidate cis-regulatory elements
publications.summary: A reference map of candidate regulatory DNA. Our collection uses its human enhancer-like subset to annotate experimental regions.
publications.note: Candidate annotations are not cell-specific functional measurements.

publications.label: Proposed starting point
publications.title: Massively parallel characterization of transcriptional regulatory elements
publications.summary: Large-scale lentiMPRA measurements in HepG2, K562, and WTC11, including a matched library designed with 60,000 constructs.
publications.note: Recommended for matched experimental comparisons and reproduction; data quantity alone does not determine the choice.

publications.label: Assay comparison
publications.title: Comprehensive evaluation of diverse massively parallel reporter assays to functionally characterize human enhancers genome-wide
publications.summary: A comparison of six K562 datasets examining coverage, processing, orientation, and agreement among reporter assays.
publications.note: Reused source measurements must not be counted as independent validation.

publications.label: Developmental evidence
publications.title: VISTA Enhancer Browser: an updated database of tissue-specific developmental enhancers
publications.summary: A database of developmental reporter experiments with tissue, embryo-stage, sequence, and allelic information.
publications.note: A sequence’s source species and the reporter’s experimental context are distinct.

publications.label: Regulatory grammar
publications.title: Design principles of cell-state-specific enhancers in hematopoiesis
publications.summary: Synthetic and genomic enhancer measurements provide a controlled route to studying motif combinations across blood-cell states.
publications.note: An alternative starting point if interactions between DNA binding sites become the main question.

publications.label: Sequence model
publications.title: Genomic language model for predicting enhancers and their allele-specific activity in the human genome
publications.summary: DNABERT-Enhancer uses DNA sequence representations to predict enhancer annotations and investigate candidate variant effects.
publications.note: Prediction probabilities and measured reporter activity answer different questions.

publications.label: Regulatory prediction
publications.title: Advancing regulatory variant effect prediction with AlphaGenome
publications.summary: A sequence model connecting long genomic context to predictions across gene regulation, chromatin, expression, and splicing.
publications.note: An optional tool for focused interpretation after the experimental analysis.

publications.label: Preprint
publications.title: AlphaGenome Atlas: in silico mutagenesis of the entire human genome improves prioritization and interpretation of non-coding variants
publications.summary: A genome-wide resource of predicted variant effects and derived annotations for prioritization and interpretation.
publications.note: The project includes the paper and supplements, not a copy of the full Atlas.

resources.title: ENCODE4 / SCREEN
resources.description: Human enhancer-like cCRE intervals, the registry paper, and supplementary materials.
resources.use: Annotate measured regions with proximal or distal enhancer-like signatures.
resources.limit: Outside the ELS subset does not mean experimentally inactive.

resources.title: ENCODE lentiMPRA
resources.description: Processed files for eight experiments, plus design and activity tables for the three-cell study.
resources.use: Compare the same constructs across HepG2, K562, and WTC11.
resources.limit: Retain cell, replicate, barcode coverage, and construct identity. Combined and per-replicate TSVs overlap.

resources.title: MPRA / STARR-seq comparison
resources.description: Author-reported calls, uniform processing, QC, reference resources, paper, and analysis code.
resources.use: Investigate the stability of activity evidence across K562 assays.
resources.limit: Establish the jointly tested regions and shared source data before estimating agreement.

resources.title: VISTA Enhancer Browser
resources.description: Eleven official data and dictionary files, together with the database publication.
resources.use: Study tissue patterns and developmental activity in defined experiments.
resources.limit: Preserve source organism, genome assembly, stage, backbone, and allelic relationships.

resources.title: Hematopoiesis MPRA
resources.description: Processed R data, published and preprint versions, supplementary tables, and author code.
resources.use: Investigate motif combinations and cell-state-specific activity.
resources.limit: Synthetic designs and processing scales require a dedicated ingestion and control analysis.

resources.title: DNABERT-Enhancer
resources.description: Publication versions, supplementary material, source snapshot, and trained-model archive.
resources.use: Evaluate an existing predictor if the experimental question calls for one.
resources.limit: Audit training overlap, input length, checkpoint identity, and runtime compatibility first.

resources.title: AlphaGenome & Atlas
resources.description: Two distinct works, supplementary files, and an AlphaGenome research-code snapshot.
resources.use: Interpret selected regions or variants through defined predicted molecular readouts.
resources.limit: Predictions are not experimental confirmation. The full Atlas is not stored in this project.
